title: Design System: Offramp Fade — Quiet Road

native.purpose: Android system typography with Material roles; commands use monospace.

narrative.overview: App-specific reference for the final implemented native Android system: warm paper and moss in light mode, Sky primary actions and darker green surfaces in dark mode. Native synthetic screen and drawable captures support the focused refinement; physical grayscale, recovery and complete accessibility acceptance remain required. DESIGN.md owns extracted primitives. This sidecar omits HTML/CSS translations because the components are native Compose, not web components.
keyCharacteristics: Static illustrated hero with text-protecting tonal veils

rules.name: Native source of truth
rules.body: Follow FadeTheme.kt, FadeScreen.kt, and QuietRoadLandscape.kt. This app reference does not define the wider Offramp family.

rules.name: Canonical logo
rules.body: Reuse ic_offramp_family at its preserved aspect ratio; do not invent brand geometry.

dos: Do preserve native text scaling, wrapping, semantics, and visible recovery actions.
Do verify implemented values through native acceptance.
donts: Don't substitute custom display fonts or a reconstructed family logo.
Don't infer rendered or physical validation from code inspection or automated tests.
